# Frozen revision 9 pre-normalization song mixing

The independent oracle executes unchanged `session_render.render_song` and captures its output immediately after HP32, before whole-song loudness measurement, fixed gain, and peak protection. The stage accepts seven aligned post-room fields: tonal left/right, bass left/right, drums left/right, and duck. It rounds the tonal-plus-bass sum, duck multiplication, and drum addition separately to Float32. Existing quiet air then adds its Double contribution to that Float32 carrier before one Float32 store. The final second-order stereo Butterworth HP32 uses Double filter state and casts output to Float32. It introduces no latency or drain. The source finite allocation includes its five-second tail; filtering continues through zero inputs inside that allocation and stops at its endpoint.

Eight synthetic cases supply independent, exact dyadic bus segments: one and two frames, Float cancellation, drum bypass of ducking, a DC hold/release, stereo impulses with a final-frame impulse, isolated air and its post-fade filter tail, and a nonzero carrier with air. Each `{start,count,values}` segment replaces the specified seven-field range; defaults are zero audio and duck one. Segments execute in listed order. Synthetic allocation length is fixed before CPython trace-local synchronization supplies the diagnostic outgoing endpoint; a temporary local clock supplies the other fade endpoints. The original fade, mix, air, and HP32 expressions execute unchanged. Absolute native fade endpoints include `frame_origin`; original local clocks subtract it.

The cancellation case distinguishes Float addition from a widened sum using `2^24 + 1`, and separate Float multiplication from a fused multiply/add. Its complete output must be exactly zero, independently of numerical tolerances. One- and two-frame outputs and the full cancellation output are frozen Float32 files; longer cases have probes, complete channel metrics, and identification hashes. Strict post-input/post-fade comparisons retain the high-pass tail, including its small nonzero samples. Native tests separately check reset, arbitrary buffer partitioning, failure rollback, overlap, bounds, and floating-point environment behavior.

Two score cases use the same 63 accepted events as the room fixture, under guitar and piano focus. Both preserve the original 3,711,911-frame allocation, local clocks, room processing, and complete-length air normalization; only the first 416,000 frames are retained. They are diagnostic score excerpts, not full-song renders. The native chain removes the 399-frame glue startup delay before passing logical song frames to room and mix. No upstream latency is added to the air clock. No finite endpoint is introduced at the excerpt boundary.

Limits were declared before native comparison: ordinary synthetic maximum error `2e-7` and RMS `2e-8`; isolated air `2e-9` and `2e-10`; score excerpts `1e-5` and `1e-6`, retaining earlier native event-endpoint tolerances; designated synthetic high-pass tail windows `1e-9` and `1e-10`. Case-level `limits` and optional `tail_limits` carry these fixed values. Candidate inventory, byte counts, finite values, probes, metrics, exact cancellation, and every candidate sample are checked. Hashes identify the freezing platform; numerical comparison handles permitted platform rounding differences. Captured input and intermediate hashes identify the pre-air and pre-high-pass boundaries without replacing the original formulas with a native-generated oracle.

`freeze-mix.py` refuses replacement without explicit `--replace` and never runs in CI. `verify-mix.py --compare .build/tonal-native/mix --evidence .build/tonal-evidence/mix` regenerates the original expectations and emits four reference/native FLOAT WAVs, with hashes, LUFS, sample peaks, and oversampled peaks. These 13-second stereo excerpts are post-room/air/HP32 and explicitly before whole-song loudness gain and peak protection. No long recording, fixture, or Python dependency enters the app bundle. Earlier fixtures and accepted sources remain unchanged.
